functions.name: DynamicTable_AppendPoints
functions.comment:
Thiscall ECX 32-byte dynamic table (data+c,growth+14,capacity+18,count+1c), stack4 source point pointer (NULL = reserve only), stack8 count n; RET8; EAX1, or0 only when count+n>capacity and growth==0. Growth adds max(growth,needed) elements via 1c5130 (always returns1). Path route tables (CLrPath+34/+54) have growth 0x80 from 1657c0/166060: first append allocates 0x400 bytes/128 points, the 129th reallocs 0x800/256 points; capacity is retained after shorter refills. ROUTE-01.2 original-code oracle (verify_route01_2_buffers.py).

Twelve fine growth requests exercise127/128/129-point boundaries and lengths181/251; shorter11-point refills retain capacity and make no Storm call.
